floor_source_subset: Actual StaticBody3D with one enabled BoxShape3D; translation-only transform inheritance, same world Y-up position frame, nominal box top and finite rectangle. Rotation, scale, constant surface velocity, missing provenance, crossed model or changed source refuses. Shape margin is retained, not added to nominal surface height or interpreted as contact.
floor_extent_rule: The measured torso's XZ projection plus an orientation-independent bound from the compiled torso half-diagonal, maximum hip offset, both leg links and foot radius must fit inside the finite floor rectangle. This is input applicability, not a behavioral acceptance threshold.
rule: Relative to V41, add four per-limb reference-selection latch bits. Establish a bit only from explicit current supporting contact during an active phase 73..359. Once established, retain that reference choice through the same stance even if actual contact disappears. Do not latch, fabricate, smooth or replace contact observations. No new gain, force estimate, dwell, phase duration, contact threshold, motor cap or physical schedule. Initialize all bits false. The selected bit is active AND phase>72 AND (eligible_previous_latch OR (presence AND bears_support)). Carry is eligible only if the previous wave is present and active, its same-limb phase is >72, and the current phase is not less than the previous phase. Clear on inactive wave, phase 0..72, missing/inactive previous wave or phase wrap; current supporting contact may immediately establish a fresh bit. Same-phase held gait input preserves eligible carry. Use the existing consecutive sample and memory provenance checks; reject missing, malformed, crossed or contradictory inputs rather than infer support. Use V41's measured-pose and floor-upright all-four-leg geometry, measured floor-relative height, joint bounds and reference slew. Hold one CURRENT latch selection mask for current and previous-wave goal computations. Retain V41's actual-contact selector for full-reference versus wave-only feedforward, existing activation/dt behavior, servo gains, host sign and all speed/impulse caps. Only the reference choice and resulting carried target positions differ.
